subject: afl-dy
title: AFL.DY.------MT.INFO.
description: Chart on book p. 103 (T(AF)M-7). AFL-DY (affinity dynamics) is the subject; MT-INFO (multi-information) is the partner. From the subject: AFI-2 (affinity insight—second degree) and ALT-C-PG (alternative composite progressionalism). From AFI-2: SOC-RT (social reality). From SOC-RT: APP-RDEF (applied redefinitions) and ALT-F (alternative functionalism). From MT-INFO: TH-CONT (thrust continuance), with the (P) prefix, "point of idea completion". From TH-CONT: T-C-IMP (time continuum implications). AFI-1 (affinity insight—first degree) is on a dotted line from TH-CONT.
